description: Check whether a complete invention document would load in a local Fyug, without playing it. Returns {loadable, module_count, connection_count}, or the error a local load_invention reports. Documents may define developments inline or use bundled content (list_developments, list_examples); this server reads no file or URL a document names and builds no output modules, and refuses documents that need them, saying which.

json.description: Complete invention JSON string (with modules, connections, etc.), at most 64 KiB.

name: check_invention
title: Check Invention
